risk.rationale: No confirmed account takeover chain. The only confirmed anomalous event (F2, Turkcell TR ASN, T1078.004) is rebutted as a non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15), not a human interactive logon, so it is not the account holder and not an imposed-credential takeover. The bulk of sign-ins (F3, PT) terminate through the university VPN vpn-edge-02 from known device LT-3104, consistent with the legitimate user. The password-spray claim fails because 193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 201 distinct MFA-completing accounts in 30 days and cross-account failures are background noise. The VPN-appliance KEV exposure is rejected because firmware 22.7R2.8 versions the relevant fixes. No data-quality conflicts. All suspicious signals are explained away; nothing remains unexplained or conflicting enough to require human escalation.
